SELECT r.id, r.req_no, r.dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, r.applicant_id, u.nickname AS applicant_name, r.expect_date, r.status, r.remark, r.create_time FROM pur_requisition r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = r.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.applicant_id AND u.deleted = 0
r.deleted = 0
AND r.req_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')
AND r.status = #{q.status} AND r.dept_id = #{q.deptId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pur_requisition_item ri WHERE ri.requisition_id = r.id AND ri.deleted = 0 AND ri.material_id = #{q.materialId})
ORDER BY r.id DESC
